packageRules.description: Framework pin (rules.md §4.7): Next.js 16, always latest 16.x patch — a major bump is a deliberate architecture event, never automated.
Editor stack is version-pinned; upgrades are deliberate events gated on the full fixture suite (rules.md §6.6) — never auto-bumped.
Docker images are pinned with a monthly patch window (rules.md §10.4).
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group non-major updates into one weekly PR to keep review load sane for a 1–2 developer team.
